layer.name: VK_LAYER_PVR_strip
layer.description: Fakes geometryShader (and, with PVR_FAKE_R2=1, VK_EXT_robustness2.nullDescriptor) so zink accepts the closed PowerVR BXM-4-64 driver; strips both before vkCreateDevice so the real driver is never asked to enable them. Enabled by PVR_FAKE_GS=1, disable with PVR_STRIP_DISABLE=1.
